info.title: Live QC API
info.description: Live QC service for the livestream-admin Live QC pages. Contract: docs/contract/live-qc-api.md.

product.description: Always `live-qc`: tells this service from another program that holds the port.

frame_url.description: Null until the first frame of this channel is captured; the same rule for local and backend channels.

live_url.description: TikTok: an http(s) URL. Shopee: an https URL on shopee.vn or shp.ee.

cookie.description: Raw `cookie` header of a banhang.shopee.vn request, required for Shopee shops.

username.description: TikTok shops only. Cannot be cleared.

live_url.description: TikTok: an http(s) URL. Shopee: an https URL on shopee.vn or shp.ee.

cookie.description: Raw `cookie` header of a banhang.shopee.vn request, Shopee shops only. Omit it to keep the stored cookie.

backend.description: Scheme and masked host of livestream-backend, e.g. `https://aut•••.example.vn`.

email.description: Masked login email, e.g. `ad•••@example.com`; empty while disconnected.

platforms.description: Platforms selected by the last start; empty while stopped.

keys.description: Monitored shop keys, or null when every shop of `platforms` is monitored.
Limit monitoring to these shops. Every start replaces the monitored set; omitting keys, or `null` as the Python tool allows, means every shop of `platforms`, while `[]` monitors none.

enabled.description: Tile mpv windows into the grid; false leaves each window where mpv opens it.

width.description: 0 for width or height means the full screen work area.

height.description: 0 for width or height means the full screen work area.

rows.description: 0 means chosen from the shop count.

columns.description: 0 means chosen from the shop count.

visible.description: False when the tile does not fit in rows × columns; the service reports every tile visible.
